# Stop-ZbxPassiveAgent

## SYNOPSIS

Stops a passive agent session.

## SYNTAX

```
Stop-ZbxPassiveAgent [-Name] <string> [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Stop-ZbxPassiveAgent cmdlet stops the passive agent session named in -Name, or each session piped from Get-ZbxPassiveAgentStatus: it closes the listener, frees the port, and removes the session from the runspace. A session also stops when the runspace closes. -WhatIf shows which session it would stop, and it writes nothing.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Stop a passive agent by name

```powershell
Start-ZbxPassiveAgent -Name 'web-agent' -Hostname 'web-01' -Port 30150
Stop-ZbxPassiveAgent -Name 'web-agent'
@(Get-ZbxPassiveAgentStatus).Count
```

Closes the session's listener (the port is free again) and disposes the session.

### Example 2: Stop every passive agent of this runspace

```powershell
Start-ZbxPassiveAgent -Name 'web-agent' -Hostname 'web-01' -Port 30150
Start-ZbxPassiveAgent -Name 'db-agent' -Hostname 'db-01' -Port 30151
Get-ZbxPassiveAgentStatus | Stop-ZbxPassiveAgent
@(Get-ZbxPassiveAgentStatus).Count
```

Get-ZbxPassiveAgentStatus writes each running session; Stop-ZbxPassiveAgent binds its Name from the pipeline.

### Example 3: Preview a stop with -WhatIf

```powershell
Start-ZbxPassiveAgent -Name 'web-agent' -Hostname 'web-01' -Port 30150
Stop-ZbxPassiveAgent -Name 'web-agent' -WhatIf
Stop-ZbxPassiveAgent -Name 'web-agent'
```

-WhatIf names the session it would stop and leaves it listening. ConfirmImpact is Medium: -Confirm asks first.

## PARAMETERS

### -Name

The session's name (the -Name it was started with).
